description: This file defines the LeaveCommentDecorator class which provides an object-oriented interface for managing leave comment entities in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for associating comments with employees, users, and leaves, and for retrieving formatted creation date and time strings.

classes.name: LeaveCommentDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the LeaveComment entity, providing utility methods for setting related entities and retrieving formatted timestamps.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a LeaveComment instance.

methods.name: getLeaveComment
methods.description: Returns the underlying LeaveComment entity instance.

methods.name: setCreatedByEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates a LeaveComment with an Employee entity identified by employee number.

methods.name: setCreatedByUserById
methods.description: Associates a LeaveComment with a User entity identified by user ID.

methods.name: setLeaveById
methods.description: Associates a LeaveComment with a Leave entity identified by leave ID.

methods.name: getCreatedAtDate
methods.description: Returns the creation date of the comment formatted as 'Y-m-d'.

methods.name: getCreatedAtTime
methods.description: Returns the creation time of the comment formatted as 'H:i'.
